title: Laser Hair Removal in Ocala, FL | GLO Aesthetics
meta: Laser hair removal in Ocala, FL for face, underarms, bikini and legs, matched to your skin and hair type. From $140 a session, no downtime. Book at GLO.
answer: Laser hair removal is a laser treatment that reduces unwanted hair by targeting follicles while the hair is actively growing. It works on the face, underarms, bikini area and larger areas like legs and back. Sessions take 15–60 minutes with no downtime. Most people need 6–8 sessions spaced 6–8 weeks apart, plus annual touch-ups.
treats_h2: What areas can laser hair removal treat?
treats_intro: Laser hair removal treats facial hair on the lip and chin, underarms, the bikini or Brazilian area, and larger areas like the legs, back and chest.
how_h2: How does laser hair removal work?
how: Laser hair removal uses a beam of light that's absorbed by the pigment in your hair. That energy turns to heat and travels down the hair shaft to damage the follicle, so it grows less hair over time. We match the laser wavelength to your skin tone and hair color — Nd:YAG technology, for example, is often preferred for darker skin. Only follicles in the active growth phase respond, which is why you need a series.
fit_h2: Is laser hair removal right for me?
good_fit: You're tired of shaving, waxing or dealing with ingrown hairs
You want smoother skin on your face, underarms, bikini area, legs, back or chest
Your hair has some natural pigment (brown or black hair responds best)
You can commit to a series of 6–8 sessions spaced 6–8 weeks apart
not_fit: Your hair in the area is very light blond, gray, white or red — the laser targets pigment, so results are limited
You're pregnant — most providers recommend waiting
You have a sunburn, fresh tan or self-tanner on the area
You have an active rash, infection or open wound in the treatment area
expect_h2: What happens during a laser hair removal appointment?
expect_intro: A laser hair removal session takes 15–60 minutes, depending on the area. You'll feel a mild snapping sensation, cooling keeps you comfortable, and there's no downtime afterward.

faq_rename.How many sessions will I need?: How many laser hair removal sessions will I need?

faq_add.a: Laser hair removal gives long-term hair reduction rather than guaranteed permanent removal. After a full series of 6–8 sessions, many clients see substantial, lasting reduction. Annual touch-ups help keep your results. Results vary from person to person.

faq_add.q: What should I do before laser hair removal?
faq_add.a: Shave the area a day or so before your session, but don't wax, pluck or thread, because the laser needs the hair root in place. Avoid tanning, sunburn and self-tanner on the area. Come with clean skin, free of lotion and deodorant.

faq_add.q: What should I avoid after laser hair removal?
faq_add.a: For about a day, skip hot showers, saunas, hot tubs and hard workouts, since heat and sweat can irritate treated skin. Protect the area from the sun and wear sunscreen. Between sessions, shave instead of waxing or plucking.
